items.title: [Makerspace] NFC Workshop
items.author: RYAN.L
items.description:
Hey Hwa Chong!
Do you know why your EZ-link card can unlock doors, or
store balances?
Want to personalise your own interactive keychain?
If so, then join us for our new NFC workshop, now open to
all students and staff!
The workshop will have two sessions. Content is the
same, so you need not attend both!
27 August 2026,
Thursday, 0900-1030
28 August 2026,
Friday, 1400-1530
Sign up at the following link:
https://forms.gle/LE1ZZxCyTdK6Tpct6
Limited slots available!
Do find some time to complete the online module MC01
https://goo.gl/forms/1fG5mrS5TalCYLrr1
if you have not done so before.
Drop by or visit us at
https://sites.google.com/hci.edu.sg/hcimakereducation/home
for
more information!
Brought to you by,
Ryan Lim
Makerspace Team
